title: Hearty Wood Fired Egyptian Cox Apple Bake
description: A romantic Egyptian dish featuring Cox apples, with a mustardy and crumbly texture, perfect for a satvik-friendly meal. This wood-fired bake is a delicious and hearty treat.
instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the sliced Cox apples, brown sugar, melted butter, Dijon mustard, ground cinnamon, ground nutmeg, and salt until the apples are well coated.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour and oat crumbs.
Add the flour mixture to the apple mixture and stir until just combined.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and bake for 35 minutes.
Remove the bake from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the Hearty Wood Fired Egyptian Cox Apple Bake warm, garnished with additional oat crumbs if desired.
